fields.description: Provider to spawn on (e.g. RunPod).
fields.label: Cloud Provider

fields.description: What this pod serves — and the key the gateway routes on, so every pod needs one. For a vLLM image the Model's intrinsic config (repo, quantization, parsers, …) is read live at build time and only per-pod tuning is set in the Serving tab; for a custom image the Model is the route key alone.
fields.label: Model
Status
fields.options:
Pending
Provisioning
Loading
Running
Stopped
Terminated

fields.description: Provider's pod id. Blank until spawned; cleared on terminate. A restart respawns → new id.
fields.label: Pod ID

fields.description: The agent that scrapes this pod's engine. Nothing installs inside the pod image, so the agent reaches it over the public engine URL. Blank = not scraped.
fields.label: Monitoring Agent

fields.description: Image to spawn, with its registry, pull credentials and engine kind.
fields.label: Engine Image

fields.description: What the image serves, mirrored from the Engine Image. 'custom' derives no vLLM arguments — the image's own entrypoint runs, plus any Startup Command.
fields.label: Engine Kind

fields.description: Provider's GPU id (e.g. 'NVIDIA L40S'). Use the Cloud Provider 'Fetch GPU Types' button for valid ids.
fields.label: GPU Type ID

fields.description: Number of GPUs to request. All the same type (homogeneous pod). Split as tensor-parallel x pipeline-parallel.
fields.label: GPU Count

fields.description: Stages to split the model's layers across (--pipeline-parallel-size). 1 = pure tensor parallel. Tensor-parallel size is derived as GPU Count / this, so both must divide the GPU count evenly.
fields.label: Pipeline Parallel Size

fields.description: Persistent volume disk, mounted at the mount path below. Survives pod restart.
fields.label: Volume (GB)

fields.description: Ephemeral container root disk. Wiped on restart.
fields.label: Container Disk (GB)

fields.description: Where the persistent volume mounts. HF_HOME defaults under here so weights survive restart.
fields.label: Volume Mount Path

fields.description: Extra env injected into the container. Merged over provisioner defaults (PUBLIC_KEY, HF_HOME, VLLM_API_KEY) — user rows win on conflict.
fields.label: Env Vars

fields.description: Filled after spawn; shared by all exposed ports. Can move on pod restart (Sync re-reads).
fields.label: Public IP

fields.description: External port mapped to internal 22. Filled after spawn.
fields.label: SSH Port

fields.description: Internal port the engine listens on — must be in the Ports table (opened at spawn). Where the health gate is polled and the gateway route points, whatever the engine kind. Reached externally via its mapped port.
fields.label: Serve Port

fields.description: TCP ports to open at spawn (the provider can't hot-add). Needs 22 (SSH) + the serve port + any extra engine ports. Defaults seeded on create.
fields.label: Ports

fields.description: Per-pod serve knobs (not model-intrinsic).
fields.label: Serve

fields.description: vLLM --api-key, injected as VLLM_API_KEY env (kept out of the visible command). Auto-generated if blank.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: → --kv-cache-dtype. fp8 halves the KV cache, which buys context on a card short of VRAM, at some accuracy. auto = the weights' own dtype.
fields.label: KV Cache Dtype

fields.description: → --max-num-seqs. Sequences the engine runs concurrently, and the gateway's admission cap: requests in flight on this engine are held to it, and one that would exceed it goes to another replica or is refused with 429. Blank = 1024, passed explicitly rather than left to the image's own default, so the gateway caps at the number the engine is actually running. Also bounds how much KV cache the batch can want, so lower it when a full batch OOMs.
fields.label: Max Num Seqs

fields.description: → --attention-backend on the serve command. auto = let vLLM pick.
fields.label: Attention Backend

fields.description: → --max-model-len. Per-box cap for the KV cache; ≤ the model's native context. Blank = 8192. Takes a suffix — 32k, 128k, 1m — or a plain token count.
fields.label: Max Model Len

fields.description: → VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1. vLLM refuses to start when Max Model Len exceeds the context the repo's config.json declares. Tick to override that guard (e.g. RoPE-extended serving). Wrong values give garbage output instead of an error, so only tick when the longer context is intended.
fields.label: Allow Long Max Model Len

fields.description: Extra --served-model-name values (comma/space separated); old client model-names keep working.
fields.label: Aliases

fields.description: Freeform extra `vllm serve` flags appended verbatim, e.g. --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-num-seqs 64.
fields.label: Extra Serve Args

fields.description: Where the gateway forwards: http://:. Derived on sync; blank when not Running. Registered as a route for this Model in the gateway.
fields.label: Engine URL

fields.description: Derived from the fields above → the pod's dockerStartCmd. Read-only; the api-key rides VLLM_API_KEY env, not shown here.
fields.label: Serve Command

fields.description: Arguments appended to the image's own entrypoint (dockerStartCmd). Used only by a custom-kind image — a vLLM image runs the derived Serve Command on the Serving tab instead. Leave blank to run the image exactly as built.
fields.label: Startup Command

fields.description: Path polled on the serve port to decide the container is actually serving: status stays Loading until it answers 200. Blank means no gate — the pod reads Running as soon as the provider says the container is up, which is earlier than it serves. A Model-serving pod falls back to vLLM's /health.
fields.label: Health Path

fields.description: Follows the pod's container logs live (last 100 lines first). Streaming stops on its own after 30 minutes.
fields.label: Start Streaming
